name: Homeward Bound
summary: Pao'ka Swiftmountain is stranded among the wyverns of Highperch. You are helping the young tauren naturalist reach the canyon floor and return toward Whitereach Post after he wandered into their nesting grounds.

sections.title: A Naturalist in Over His Head
sections.body: Pao'ka Swiftmountain came to Thousand Needles with the elder Motega Firemane. They meant to study the canyon floor's wildlife and towering stone pillars. Curious and too sure of himself, Pao'ka went alone into Highperch to watch its wyverns up close. The territorial beasts drove him off. Now the young scholar has spent days frightened and stranded among the crags.

sections.title: The Path Down the Crags
sections.body: Aggressive wyverns guard their clutches and high roosts throughout Highperch. You clear a way through the nesting predators so Pao'ka can reach level ground. The panicked youth cannot defend himself in the open, and relies on passing Horde travelers to fend off the wyverns. He needs to reach the safer canyon path leading east.

sections.title: Relief and Reckoning
sections.body: Pao'ka reaches the base of the cliffs and can make his way home to Whitereach Post. Motega Firemane is stunned by what happened. He had promised Pao'ka's hesitant father that he would watch over the boy during their field studies. Relieved that Pao'ka survived his reckless expedition, Motega rewards those who saved him. In private, he wishes he had chained the apprentice to a totem.

faq.answer: Pao'ka Swiftmountain is a young tauren apprentice who came to Thousand Needles with Motega Firemane to study and record wild creatures. His youthful enthusiasm led him alone into Highperch.

faq.q: Why was Pao'ka hiding in Highperch?
faq.answer: Pao'ka went alone into the roosts to observe the native wyverns and their nests up close. The aggressive beasts attacked him, forcing him into hiding and trapping him on the high mesa.
Motega Firemane is a tauren naturalist stationed at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. Pao'ka's father entrusted him with the youth's safety during their field studies.

aliases: where do i escort him from
faq.answer: Highperch is a raised mesa and wyvern nesting ground in western Thousand Needles. It lies just west of Whitereach Post and northwest of Freewind Post.
Whitereach Post is a small Horde encampment east of Highperch in Thousand Needles. Tauren naturalists use it as a field base while studying the canyon's wildlife.

faq.q: Does Motega know Pao'ka was missing?
aliases: why didn't motega search for him
faq.answer: No. Pao'ka slipped away to Highperch without telling Motega. Motega did not know his apprentice was in danger until you report the rescue.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the duties shared by tribes and elders. Motega's promise to Pao'ka's father reflects the bonds that guide their field studies.
As Horde, you may know wyverns as allies and mounts across Kalimdor. The wild wyverns of Highperch draw interest for their nature and strategic value.
